program_name: Bachelor of Arts (Honours) in Interior Architecture

fees.notes: Official Sunway University international student annual fee (Year 2026): USD 10,291, published on the programme page and payable in RM equivalent at the prevailing exchange rate. Total (USD 36,018.5) derived as annual fee x 3.5 years. Source: https://sunwayuniversity.edu.my/faculty-of-arts-and-social-sciences/courses/bachelor-of-arts-honours-interior-architecture, fetched 2026-09-18.

requirements.general: STPM: Average C or CGPA 2.0 (minimum 2 principals) A-Level: Minimum 8 points (Grade D in at least 2 subjects) Australian Matriculation: ATAR 55 Canadian Matriculation: 55% Monash University Foundation Year: 55% Sunway Foundation in Arts/Science & Technology: CGPA 2.0 UEC: Maximum 30 points from 5 subjects (all Grade Bs) International Baccalaureate: Minimum 24 points (excluding bonus points) Sunway Diploma in Related Field: CAVG 50% or CGPA 2.0 (advanced standing possible) Portfolio Review: Minimum 5 architecture-related works (pencil/ink sketches, AutoCAD drawings, 3D models, hand-drafted designs) English Language: IELTS 6.0, MUET Band 4, SPM English B, UEC English B6, O-Level English Credit, Sunway IEP Level 4 (65%)
